Also instead of returning empty string, lets return the input parameter in case of any error. That is also what doxygen says.
Addressed. Currently, this API throws exception in case of any error. Kept the same behaviour.
Why are we returning unexpanded location code from an API that expects expanded location code to be returned?
I accidentally gave wrong name to the variable. It's actually holding the expanded location code read from PIM. Will update the variable name.
How are you sure that at the point when this API is getting called. Location code are expanded or unexpanded?

We are reading the "LocationCode" property from PIM. In ideal scenario, the "LocationCode" should be expanded if VPD has been collected for this FRU. 

Do you mean we should have additional logic to check if the "LocationCode" property on PIM is unexpanded? If so, this logic is not implemented currently, and needs to be added. I think that is out of scope for this patch and needs to be handled as a separate patch.
Updated the comment as discussed

The PDI does not say that this API will throw "DbusInternalFailure".
This violates the agreement.
In case of any error lets return what we got in the parameter as input.
